fault_injection: One-time ingestion embedding error, test wrapper only
checks: new corpus dialog validates IDs and selects the created corpus without stale answer/evidence
empty selected corpus does not retrieve the default corpus document
recoverable ingestion failure exposes Retry, requeues the same job and completes indexing
query and evidence use the selected corpus after retry
corpus switching updates documents, counts and server-filtered question history
embedding-space mismatch shows the restore-or-new-corpus guidance
corpus selector is available on mobile without page overflow
scope: Actual browser against FastAPI, durable Worker and PGlite PostgreSQL/pgvector in an isolated process namespace. Deterministic mock providers; no hosted models or paid endpoint calls. Workflow verification does not measure model quality or native PostgreSQL deployment behavior.
